command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
d <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Area")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Missing required columns")
mix <- d[d$StrainNumber == "287_98", , drop = FALSE]
parts <- strsplit(mix$Ratio, ":", fixed = TRUE)
if (any(lengths(parts) != 2L)) stop("Invalid ratio")
numer <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[[1]]), numeric(1))
denom2 <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[[2]]), numeric(1))
frequency <- numer / (numer + denom2)
y <- as.numeric(mix$Area)
keep <- is.finite(frequency) & is.finite(y)
frequency <- frequency[keep]
y <- y[keep]
if (length(y) != 36L) stop(sprintf("Expected 36 complete mixture observations, got %d", length(y)))
fit_data <- data.frame(y = y, frequency = frequency)
models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(y ~ poly(frequency, degree = 2, raw = TRUE), data = fit_data),
  cubic = lm(y ~ poly(frequency, degree = 3, raw = TRUE), data = fit_data),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(y ~ splines::ns(frequency, df = 4), data = fit_data)
)
n_used <- vapply(models, nobs, numeric(1))
if (length(unique(n_used)) != 1L) stop("Candidate models used different row counts")
aic <- vapply(models, AIC, numeric(1))
rss <- vapply(models, deviance, numeric(1))
adj_r2 <- vapply(models, function(m) summary(m)$adj.r.squared, numeric(1))
best_name <- names(which.min(aic))[[1]]
best_model <- models[[best_name]]
lower <- min(frequency)
upper <- max(frequency)
grid <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 200001L)
grid_pred <- as.numeric(predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(frequency = grid)))
imax <- which.max(grid_pred)
left <- grid[max(1L, imax - 2L)]
right <- grid[min(length(grid), imax + 2L)]
if (imax == 1L || imax == length(grid)) {
  optimal_frequency <- grid[[imax]]
  maximum_predicted_area <- grid_pred[[imax]]
} else {
  opt <- optimize(
    function(z) as.numeric(predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(frequency = z))),
    interval = c(left, right), maximum = TRUE,
    tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5
  )
  candidates_x <- c(lower, upper, opt$maximum)
  candidates_y <- as.numeric(predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(frequency = candidates_x)))
  ibest <- which.max(candidates_y)
  optimal_frequency <- candidates_x[[ibest]]
  maximum_predicted_area <- candidates_y[[ibest]]
}
audit <- data.frame(
  model = names(models),
  n = as.integer(n_used),
  coefficients = vapply(models, function(m) length(coef(m)), integer(1)),
  AIC = as.numeric(aic),
  RSS = as.numeric(rss),
  adjusted_R2 = as.numeric(adj_r2),
  selected = names(models) == best_name,
  lower_frequency = lower,
  upper_frequency = upper,
  optimal_frequency = ifelse(names(models) == best_name, optimal_frequency, NA_real_),
  maximum_predicted_area = ifelse(names(models) == best_name, maximum_predicted_area, NA_real_),
  row.names = NULL
)
write.table(audit, file = "model_result.tsv", sep = "	", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
RSCRIPT
